Every score is the share of the ground truth that a run reproduced (identical, or correlation of
at least 0.99; groups with exactly the same members), so what a run does not have lowers its
score. The scores are written by the four `ScenarioN_comparison.qmd` reports
(`metrics/scores_ScenarioN.csv`); render those first.

```{r}
source("evaluation/Comparison/helpers.R")

scenario_names = c("1" = "1. Deconvolution", "2" = "2. CellTFusion", "3" = "3. pipeML", "4" = "4. RaCInG")

scores = data.frame()
for (s in 1:4) {
  tab = read.csv(paste0("evaluation/Comparison/metrics/scores_Scenario", s, ".csv"))[, c("run", "comparison", "score")]
  scores = rbind(scores, cbind(scenario = scenario_names[[as.character(s)]], tab))
}
scores$run = factor(scores$run, levels = agent_runs)
```

## Scores of every comparison

```{r}
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-width: 8
scores$comparison = factor(scores$comparison, levels = rev(unique(scores$comparison)))

ggplot(scores, aes(run, comparison, fill = score)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::percent(score, accuracy = 1)), size = 3) +
  facet_grid(scenario ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#f0efec", high = "#2a78d6", limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
  theme(legend.position = "right", axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), panel.grid = element_blank(),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Reproduced")

save_figure("Summary/scores", 8, 8)
```

Mean score of each run in each scenario.

```{r}
mean_scores = aggregate(score ~ scenario + run, scores, mean)
kable(reshape(mean_scores, idvar = "scenario", timevar = "run", direction = "wide"), digits = 2, row.names = FALSE,
      col.names = c("Scenario", agent_runs))
```

## What each run did

From the event logs (`metrics/run_metrics.csv`): whether the run asked for the CIBERSORTx
credentials, time and cost of the analysis (debrief and export not counted), technical restarts
and whether it reached the 4-hour limit of a turn.

```{r}
metrics = read.csv("evaluation/Comparison/metrics/run_metrics.csv")
metrics$run = paste(metrics$arm, metrics$model)
metrics = metrics[order(metrics$scenario, match(metrics$run, agent_runs)), ]

kable(metrics[, c("scenario", "run", "asked_cibersortx_credentials", "time_min", "cost_usd", "tool_calls", "mcp_calls",
                  "restarts_after_stall", "timeouts")],
      row.names = FALSE, col.names = c("Scenario", "Run", "Asked credentials", "Time (min)", "Cost (USD)", "Tool calls",
                                       "MCP calls", "Restarts", "Timeouts"))
```

Totals over the four scenarios.

```{r}
totals = aggregate(cbind(time_min, cost_usd, tool_calls, tool_errors) ~ run, metrics, sum, na.action = na.pass)
totals = totals[match(agent_runs, totals$run), ]
kable(totals, digits = 1, row.names = FALSE, col.names = c("Run", "Time (min)", "Cost (USD)", "Tool calls", "Tool errors"))
```
